title: A Lymphoid-Enriched Spatial Immune Niche Defines an Immunotherapy-Responsive State in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
snippet: Atezolizumab plus bevacizumab is a first-line therapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet only a subset of patients achieve durable benefit. The spatial organization of the tumour microenvironment (TME) and its relationship to immunotherapy response remain incompletely understood.
